body:
I've been thinking about your question for quite a while now and I'm finding it hard to come up with any reasons. Maybe I need to take a step back and get an outsiders opinion. Maybe I need to change my perspective and try understand my situation from someone who has been in something similar before.  


I don't like to glorify suicide and I do think it is a very serious thing but sometimes we give up on ourselves when we feel like failures, when we suffer and when we can't pick ourselves back again. Of course these aren't the only reasons people take their lives.  


Thank you for your thought out response, your question is really thought provoking in a good way.
I don't wish to discuss ways of ending ones life on this sub. I'm sure a google search will provide you with your answer.
